retry.policy: 沿用 provider/mod.rs::retry_provider_timeout 既有预算；已发 delta 后禁止自动重试；TUI 层不叠加重试

concurrency_lock.mechanism: SHUTDOWN_REQUESTED AtomicBool + control_plane.stop_turn 既有接缝
concurrency_lock.guarantee: 退出路径单一写主；在飞 turn 取消后最多等待 external_call_timeout_ms 即强制收敛，不留持有 tty 的活线程

logging.sink: PONY_TUI_RUNTIME_LOG（stderr 重定向成功后改道），无新增日志出口

resource_release: join/drop turn thread with bounded timeout
restore_terminal_modes (raw mode + alternate screen + input protocols)
